test_title: PYST 52: SSC GD Constable - English (Held on: 8th December 2021 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

Treasure Island is / always been / my favourite book / right from my childhood days
solution:
The erroneous part is: **Treasure Island is**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The use of 'been' in the second part of the sentence implies that the context is in the **perfect tense**.
